en.name: Egg crepe wrappers (danbing pi)
en.summary: Fresh refrigerated egg crepe wrappers keep 1–2 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, and 2 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F). No figure is published for 蛋餅皮 specifically — these are the numbers for fresh pasta, the closest equivalent: an unpreserved fresh wheat dough sold chilled.
en.pantry: These are not a cupboard item. A danbing sheet is a thin wheat batter with nothing in it to preserve it — no acid, no salt to speak of, no drying — so it sits at fridge temperature from the shop to your pan. Out of the fridge give the pack two hours at most, or one hour above 32 °C (90 °F). A sealed supermarket pack carries its own printed date and that date governs while the pack is closed; once it is open, the numbers here apply.
en.fridge: 1–2 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below for an opened pack or for sheets you have made yourself, kept flat with the interleaving paper in place and wrapped so the edges do not dry. Treat that as guidance read across from fresh pasta rather than as a published danbing figure. Supermarket packs carry a longer printed date because they are sealed and often part-cooked, so follow the date while the pack is intact and switch to this window once you break the seal.
en.freezer: 2 months at −18 °C (0 °F). Freeze with the interleaving sheets in place — without them the batter sheets weld into a solid block — and peel them apart while they are still frozen, which works cleanly. Lay the stack flat in a bag with the air pressed out. Cook straight from frozen in an oiled pan over medium heat; a thawed sheet goes sticky and tears when you try to lift it.
en.thawing: Do not thaw them. Peel the sheets apart while frozen and cook them straight from the freezer. A thawed wrapper is sticky and tears.
spoilage: A sour or fermented smell when the pack is opened.
A slimy or tacky film on the surface of the sheets.
Grey, pink or fuzzy spots anywhere on the dough.
Sheets that have dried hard and cracked at the edges.
tips: Keep the interleaving paper in place, both in the fridge and in the freezer.
Wrap the stack airtight; the edges dry out within a day.
Freeze on the day you buy them rather than at the end of the fridge window.
Cook from frozen; do not thaw.

faq.q: How long do egg crepe wrappers keep?
faq.a: 1–2 days in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below once the pack is open, or 2 months frozen at −18 °C. A sealed pack follows its own printed date.
Yes, 2 months at −18 °C. Keep the interleaving paper between them and peel them apart while still frozen.

faq.q: Do I need to thaw them before cooking?
faq.a: No. Cook them straight from frozen. A thawed sheet turns sticky and tears when you lift it.

zh.name: 蛋餅皮
zh.summary: 冷藏的新鮮蛋餅皮在 4 °C 以下可放 1～2 天，冷凍 −18 °C 下 2 個月。並沒有針對「蛋餅皮」公布的數字——這組數字來自新鮮義大利麵，那是最接近的對應品：同樣是冷藏販售、沒有任何保存處理的新鮮麵團。
zh.pantry: 它不是櫥櫃食品。蛋餅皮是一張薄薄的小麥粉漿，裡面沒有任何能保存它的東西——沒有酸、幾乎沒有鹽、也沒有乾燥——所以從店裡到你的平底鍋之間，它都應該待在冷藏溫度。離開冰箱最多兩小時，氣溫超過 32 °C 時最多一小時。超市的密封包有自己印的日期，未拆封時以那個日期為準；一旦拆封，就套用這裡的數字。
zh.fridge: 拆封後的包裝或自己做的餅皮，在 4 °C 以下可放 1～2 天，要平放、保留中間的隔紙，並包好避免邊緣乾裂。請把這當成比照新鮮義大利麵得來的參考，而不是蛋餅皮專屬的公布數字。超市包裝之所以印著比較長的日期，是因為它密封、而且往往已經半熟；未拆封請依日期，拆封後就換成這個期限。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下 2 個月。冷凍時一定要保留隔紙——沒有隔紙，粉漿皮會凍成一整塊——而且要趁還結凍時把它們剝開，那時最好剝。整疊平放裝袋、把空氣壓出來。要煎時直接從冷凍下鍋，中火加一點油；解凍過的餅皮會發黏，一拿就破。
zh.thawing: 不要解凍。趁結凍時把餅皮剝開，直接下鍋。解凍後的餅皮會黏、會破。
spoilage: 拆封時聞到酸味或發酵味。
餅皮表面出現黏滑或發黏的薄膜。
麵團上出現灰色、粉紅或絨毛狀的斑點。
tips: 不論冷藏或冷凍，隔紙都要留著。
整疊密封包好，邊緣一天就會乾掉。
買回來當天就冷凍，不要拖到冷藏期限的最後。
從冷凍直接下鍋，不要解凍。

faq.a: 拆封後冷藏 4 °C 以下 1～2 天，或 −18 °C 冷凍 2 個月。未拆封的包裝依其標示日期。
可以，−18 °C 下 2 個月。中間要夾隔紙，並趁結凍時剝開。
不需要，直接從冷凍下鍋。解凍過的餅皮會發黏、一拿就破。
